reasons: The document contained no insurance provision; a single concise inserted sub-clause supplies every preferred element (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M tied to Customer Data processing, statutory workers' comp, certificates on request).
No post-termination tail, audit rights, additional-insured, or other extras beyond the preferred position were added, so the insertion is minimal for an absent clause.
The existing risk-of-loss allocation in 14.12 is untouched and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ('Term' and 'Customer Data' are agreement-level concepts).
